quotes.text: 3e. En su ocupación ... (la que habitualmente le lleva más horas) La semana pasada, ¿trabajó el ...? ¿Cuántas horas trabajó el ...? ... Total de horas
1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa? ... 2. ¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?

assessments.reasoning: The survey records hours worked in paid employment (e.g., Question 3e in the individual questionnaire). In Block VII of the household questionnaire, questions identify who performs most household tasks and who assists, but no time or duration is recorded for unpaid domestic or care work. There are no time use questions for leisure or self-care. Per the specific rule provided for this indicator ('If the instrument only records hours of paid work, with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false'), all four elements evaluate to false.
